```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
```

Load data
```{r}
insects <- read_csv2("data/insect_raw/Data_Uhler_2021_main.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
```

Check pre-existing NA content
```{r}
insects %>%
  miss_var_summary()
```

Look for hidden NAs
```{r}
insects %>%
  summary()
```
